accepted_reasoning: The manifest, separately scoped roles, verification floors, verifier policy, response contracts, receipt contracts, and supersession rule must bind the same unchanged package.
Splitting any one of those bindings permits byte drift, authority ambiguity, or verification-floor bypass.
Checker code, transport, canonical locations, migration, external L2, promotion, and publication remain safely deferrable without breaking Design closure.
balancer_clarifications: Revision @3 is the only current candidate; revisions @1 and @2 were never accepted and remain superseded evidence only.
Exactness uses three declared layers: SHA-256 over raw regular-file bytes, RFC 8785 over the sorted path/digest package projection, and RFC 8785 over the manifest with only manifest_digest removed.

Victor Boscaro's proposed verification power is structural only. It can block inadmissible evidence but cannot accept or reject semantics, discharge obligations, or authorize promotion or publication.
A structurally eligible joined package is still only an input to a separate lifecycle decision; verification is not semantic truth or admission.

do_not_split: verification levels from the frozen package
digest methods from owner responses and verification receipts

do_not_merge: Rondelli semantic ownership with Victor structural verification
the sixteen Rondelli role meanings into one ambient permission
V1 automated checking with V2 direct verification

recomposition_proof: Start with the current @3 manifest and reproduce all three digest layers. Resolve each OAR slice to its exact Rondelli role, scope, non-scope, and verification floor. Join only an exact owner response and the required current V1 or V2 structural receipt that repeat the same methods, package, role, scope, currentness, and claim ceiling. The result is structural eligibility for a separate lifecycle decision and nothing more.
claim_ceiling: Design coherence and exact candidate-byte recomposition only; no owner response, verifier acceptance, validator execution, role admission, migration, promotion, publication, or semantic closure.
next_route: protected exact Rondelli @3 owner-response gate, followed separately by Victor @3 identity-role-policy and V2 verification gates
